messages:
Alex W: Quick heads up — I just reproduced an implicit-admin path in the Console when editing project settings via a deep link. Steps below, repro on prod and staging.

Alex W: Repro steps: open /console/projects/42?edit=true as a viewer user who also has an org-level admin flag set on the old role_alias migration. UI shows edit controls and POST succeeds.

Alex W: curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/projects/42/update -H 'Authorization: Bearer user-token' -d '{"name":"test"}'
```

Maria S: Whoa. Are there audit log entries for that update? Do we see role in the audit?

Alex W: Yes — audit shows: `event: project_update, user_id: U123, role_claim: viewer, effective_role: admin` — mismatch in the record.

Kevin L: Sounds like two possible problems: 1) UI gating is missing (should've disabled the edit button) 2) server-side permission translation/migration promoted the effective role. Which one allowed the write?

Raj P: I'm looking at the migration that mapped legacy role_alias -> role_id. There's an old code path that defaults to admin if role_alias is null and a KMS-signed token is missing the role field. KMS integration recently changed signing schema in 2025-12. Could be token parsing fallback.

Maria S: @oncall-security-bot can you open an incident and add severity=P2 until we confirm blast radius? Also add an audit retention tag. :warning:

oncall-security-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created (sev=P2). Owner: Raj P. Links: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-042

Raj P: Triage notes: likely root cause = migration + KMS signing mismatch -> null role_claim -> fallback to admin in legacy resolver. Immediate mitigation: add explicit server-side permission assert before applying project updates (deny if role != editor/admin). Also add short-circuit that treats missing token as deny, not default to admin.

Kevin L: Good. I'll make a small console change to ensure UI gating is defensive (disable edit links for viewers even if backend temporarily misreports). Patch rolling to canary now (console v1.2.7-canary). ETA ~15m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Alex W: Adding audit tag `rbac_mismatch` to events so we can query all affected updates. SQL snippet for query: 
```
SELECT * FROM audit_events WHERE tag='rbac_mismatch' AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days';
```

Maria S: Also check Dedicated/Private deploys — the migration might have been applied inconsistently. If KMS signing change was staged, some clusters could still be using old token verifier. Raj, can you validate config across regions?

Raj P: Will run config diff across prod/staging/ap-southeast. If confirmed, will prepare a coordinated patch and hotfix notes for enterprise customers.

Kevin L: Rolling patch applied to canary, no anomalous writes seen in next 10m. Will promote if clean.

Alex W: Thanks all. After canary/patch, let's do a short postmortem and add an automated test that simulates missing role_claim tokens. Tagging this convo for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
